title.narrative: Welthungerhilfe Anticipatory Humanitarian Action Facility (WAHAFA) FUEL Project

description.narrative: The objective of the intervention is to undertake pre-agreed pre-emptive actions based on the predicted drought situation before adverse humanitarian impacts of the drought start to manifest on the target populations in Maikona and Kargi. These activities would mitigate against the potential humanitarian impacts such as food security, water scarcity, scarcity of livestock feeds and high incidences of livestock diseases.

The participants of this action will be households and persons within the Anticipatory Action Plan (AAP) regions. The community participants will be identified in a participatory way in open community engagement meetings.

The project is an anticipatory action for the drought hazard in Marsabit. It aims at the implementation of selected and prioritized actions based on a participatory process with the target communities, stakeholders and system actors. This process had been undertaken during the WAHAFA build pillar in which the target communities in Maikona and Kargi were supported to undertake risk and vulnerability analyses and eventually synthesize the anticipatory action plans for the drought hazard. Key actions prioritized included: the development and dissemination of early warning messages, rehabilitation of strategic water sources, early cash, distribution of livestock feeds, livestock disease surveillance and sensitization on livestock offtake through local markets.
